description: Authoritative registry of rejection and failure codes used by AGCP HTTP interfaces, Governance Evidence, conformance tests, and implementation error reporting.

fields.default_http_status: Default HTTP status code for HTTP interfaces.
fields.retryable: Whether the same request may succeed without changing authoritative governance inputs.
fields.governance_stage: Primary AGCP stage or supporting service associated with the code.
fields.governance_evidence: Whether Governance Evidence is normally required when the error is attributable to a governed object.
fields.description: Normative description of the rejection condition.

codes.description: The same Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request payload for the same tenant and endpoint.
The request, Proposal, governance artifact, or submitted object failed required schema validation.
Required provenance, signature, attribution, or binding information is invalid, missing, expired, unverifiable, or not logically associated with the governed object.
The tenant state does not permit the requested governance operation.
The request attempts to access, operate on, or infer a resource outside the authorized tenant scope.
The request violates governance-domain isolation, domain sovereignty, or governed cross-domain authority requirements.
The requested resource was not found or is intentionally hidden by a cross-scope disclosure policy.
The requested Proposal does not exist within the authorized tenant and governance-domain scope.
The requested Execution Authorization does not exist within the authorized tenant and governance-domain scope.
The requested Governance Evidence record does not exist within the authorized tenant and governance-domain scope.
The requested governance artifact does not exist within the authorized tenant and governance-domain scope.
No applicable governance policy could be resolved for the Proposal under the relevant tenant, governance-domain, Canonical State, and governance context.
A required Policy Evaluation Module or policy-evaluation dependency is unavailable.
A Policy Evaluation Module failed determinism validation or was detected to depend on nondeterministic inputs or behavior.
Policy evaluation produced missing, malformed, unsupported, or non-conformant output.
The Proposal failed structural or prerequisite qualification and was structurally refused.
The Governance Decision Function produced Denied as the authoritative governance outcome.
The Governance Decision Function produced Pending Human Review as the authoritative governance outcome.
The requested operation cannot proceed until governed re-evaluation occurs.
Execution Authorization failed or did not produce Authorized for Commit Boundary Processing.
The supplied Execution Authorization is missing, invalid, expired, revoked, consumed, not bound to the Action, or otherwise unsuitable for Commit Boundary processing.
The Action is not authorized for Commit Boundary processing.
The requested governance-significant execution requires successful Commit Boundary processing before it may become operationally real.
Commit Boundary processing failed because one or more commit prerequisites were not satisfied.
The qualified Action Representation changed after qualification or no longer matches the authoritative qualified Proposal.
The Governance Context is missing, invalid, stale, inconsistent, or no longer suitable for the requested governed operation.
Canonical State is incomplete, inconsistent, unverifiable, stale, unsuitable, or fails integrity, provenance, freshness, or consistency validation.
Required Canonical State cannot be resolved or made available for governance evaluation.
Authority Lineage is missing, invalid, incomplete, expired, unverifiable, or not sufficient for the requested governance operation.
Required authority or delegated authority has been revoked.
The request attempts unauthorized replay or reuse of authority, delegation, approval, or authorization material.
A human-review artifact is malformed, invalid, unauthoritative, insufficient, or not bound to the Proposal.
A human-review artifact, approval, cosign, or adjudication artifact is expired and cannot be considered.
A governance-significant artifact failed integrity, structure, provenance, authority, invariant, or validation requirements.
The actor, authority, tenant, or governance domain is not authorized to register, modify, activate, retire, or otherwise affect the governance artifact.
The governance artifact cannot become operationally effective because validation, authority, invariant, prerequisite, or self-protection requirements are not satisfied.
Governance Evidence is missing required fields or is insufficient to establish required processing state, traceability, attribution, or replayability.
Governance Evidence is corrupted, unverifiable, non-attributable, out of order, not logically associated with the governed object, or otherwise invalid.
Deterministic replay was rejected because required evidence, authoritative inputs, Canonical State references, integrity checks, or governance interpretation could not be reproduced.
An implementation failure prevented the request from completing. This code SHALL NOT be used to mask deterministic governance failures that have a more specific rejection code.
